catalogDescription: A meditative sequence of black and white spatial inquiries.

sections.title: 01. Archival Mission
sections.content: JWY PHOTO BOOK is a personal digital monograph archive founded in Seoul, Korea.

books.title: #001 Nogodan
books.subtitle: Nogodan is a major peak in Jirisan National Park, located in Gurye County, South Jeolla Province, South Korea. Standing at 1,507 meters above sea level, it is famous for its sweeping cloud seas and accessible hiking trails.
